summary.text: Steven Roberts, a Democrat, represents Missouri Senate District 5, part of the City of St. Louis; he was sworn in on January 6, 2021, and is Assistant Minority Floor Leader.
He previously served two terms in the Missouri House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Roberts is a fourth-generation St. Louis native.
He holds a Bachelor of Science in Psychology and Communication Studies from the University of Miami and a law degree from Pepperdine University School of Law.
After law school he joined AP Wireless Infrastructure Partners, LLC as an attorney, and later served as a prosecutor for the City of St. Louis.
He is a Captain in the Missouri Air National Guard, serving as Deputy Staff Judge Advocate for the 131st Bomb Wing, and is General Counsel to the Roberts Companies.
While in the House he was selected by his colleagues as Chairman of the Missouri Legislative Black Caucus.
In November 2024 he was re-elected to the Senate with 89% of the vote.
Roberts lives in the City of St. Louis.
